label: Port Scan Rate
help_text: Probes per second during port scanning. Lower values reduce network impact.

label: ARP Scan Rate
help_text: ARP packets per second during host discovery. Keep low on networks with strict switch policies.

label: ARP Retries
help_text: Additional ARP rounds for non-responsive hosts. Total attempts = retries + 1.

label: Port Scan Batch Size
help_text: Ports scanned concurrently per host. Range: 16-1000.

label: Probe Raw Socket Ports
help_text: Scan ports 9100-9107. May cause ghost printing on some printers.

label: ARP Scan Cutoff
help_text: Interfaced subnets larger than this CIDR prefix are truncated during ARP scanning. Lower values scan more IPs — increase ARP Scan Rate accordingly for large subnets.

label: Use Npcap ARP (Windows)
help_text: Use Npcap broadcast ARP instead of Windows SendARP. Requires Npcap installed.

label: Full Scan Interval
help_text: Run a full 65k port scan every N scans. Other scans use a lighter port set for faster results. Set to 0 for light scans only, 1 for every scan to be full.
